What we do

Services

Everything a Web3 or AI project needs to grow, from the first community member to the top of AI search results.

We build engaged communities from scratch and scale them with systems that keep people coming back.

  • Governance structures that give members a voice

Credibility decides who wins in Web3. We help founders build trust with users, investors, and media.

  • Media strategy and press coverage

  • Crisis communication and reputation management

People now ask AI who to trust. We make sure ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini find and recommend your project.

  • AI visibility audits across major LLMs
  • Content strategy built for AI retrieval
  • Brand positioning in AI-generated answers
  • Ongoing monitoring with our tool, Pulse
